description: collections_search for the United States, 1760-1860, captured live from FamilySearch on 2026-11-05 (issue #4163). Unlike collections-search-us-national (1860-1910 only), it includes the 1790-1840 federal censuses, so a plan can reach an early census. Its '~United States' predicate matches every US place, so it must come AFTER the state and county collections fixtures in mcp_fixtures.
